title: Sci-Fi
story: Gadgets and ships from a far-away space adventure.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round flying saucer: a wide flat disc with a smooth glass dome on top and a ring of eight round lights around the underside of the rim, flying level.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey, green glass dome, small orange lights

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A slim rocket flying upward: white tube body, red pointed nose cone, one round yellow porthole, three red fins at the base, and a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling downward from the nozzle, and warm orange light cast on the rocket.
cards.hero_colors: white, red nose and fins, small yellow porthole

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite: a box-shaped gold foil body with two long rectangular blue solar panels attached on its left and right sides and a small round white dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold foil, dark blue panels, white dish

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A perfectly round white space helmet with a big curved gold visor and a thick grey neck ring with one orange connector on the side.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, grey ring, small orange connector

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A small moon buggy with four wire-mesh wheels, an open white body with two seats, and a round dish antenna on a short mast at the front.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey wheels, orange seat cushions

cards.name: Lunar Lander
cards.subject: A lunar lander resting on the ground: an eight-sided gold foil body with one square window, and four grey legs angled outward from the body, each ending in a flat round foot.
cards.hero_colors: gold foil, grey legs, small light blue window

cards.name: Star Chart
cards.subject: A flat rectangular dark blue sheet lying flat, covered with white dots joined by thin white lines and one ringed-planet icon in a corner.
cards.hero_colors: dark blue, white lines, yellow dots

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A spaceship control console: a sloped grey metal panel with a round screen showing a radar sweep icon, a row of colored buttons, two levers and a round dial, standing under a round window full of stars.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal, red and green buttons
cards.surface_or_setting: spaceship cabin floor under a round window

cards.name: Airlock Door
cards.subject: A closed round steel hatch door set into a wall, with a yellow-black hazard frame, hinges on the left, a red lever handle on the right and a small round window, seen from the corridor side.
cards.hero_colors: light grey, yellow frame, red handle
cards.surface_or_setting: grey metal panel wall of a spaceship corridor

cards.name: Solar Panel
cards.subject: A single large rectangular solar panel with a grid of square cells, tilted back and fixed to the top of a stout grey post that stands on a wide flat round grey base, with one small green light on the post.
cards.hero_colors: dark blue panel, grey post and base, small green light

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A retro flying saucer: a wide flat disc with a rounded glass dome on top, a silver rim and a row of round lights under the rim, flying level.
cards.hero_colors: bright green body, silver rim, yellow lights

cards.name: Retro Rocket
cards.subject: A chubby chrome rocket flying upward: round silver body, red pointed nose, a round yellow window, three red fins at the base, and a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling downward, and warm orange light cast on the rocket.
cards.hero_colors: silver chrome, red nose and fins, yellow window

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite: a silver box body with two long rectangular blue solar panels attached to its left and right sides and a round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: silver body, blue panels, gold foil strip

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A perfectly round orange space helmet with a large curved dark navy visor and a white neck ring.
cards.hero_colors: orange, dark navy visor, white ring

cards.name: Moon Boots
cards.subject: A pair of chunky white space boots with thick grey soles and a wide strap across each ankle.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey soles, blue strap

cards.name: Space Shuttle
cards.subject: A space shuttle orbiter sitting on its three landing wheels: white fuselage with a black nose and black belly, swept triangular wings, a tall tail fin with a red stripe, and a rounded cockpit window.
cards.hero_colors: white, black nose, red tail stripe

cards.name: Radar Screen
cards.subject: A square grey metal monitor on a short stand with a perfectly round dark green screen showing a light-green sweep line and small blips, and one orange knob below the screen.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal, green screen, orange knob

cards.name: Binoculars
cards.subject: Binoculars: two parallel black tubes joined by a central bridge with a round focus wheel in the middle, a wide round lens at the front of each tube and a smaller eyepiece at the back.
cards.hero_colors: black, silver focus wheel, red ring around the lenses

cards.name: Observatory
cards.subject: A tall simple observatory: a round white tower topped by a white half-sphere dome with a vertical open slit, a grey door at the base and a gold band under the dome.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey door, gold band

cards.name: Porthole
cards.subject: A perfectly round window with a thick grey metal ring and eight bolts, set in a wall, with blue glass showing white stars.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal, blue glass, white stars
cards.surface_or_setting: grey metal wall of a spaceship

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A flying saucer: a wide flat purple disc with a glass dome on top and a ring of round yellow lights around the rim, flying level.
cards.hero_colors: purple, teal dome, yellow lights

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A red rocket flying upward: slim red body, white pointed nose, three white fins, a round blue window, and a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling downward from the nozzle, and warm orange light cast on the rocket.
cards.hero_colors: red, white nose and fins, blue window

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite: a white box body with gold bands, two long rectangular dark blue solar panels attached on its left and right sides and a round white dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold bands, dark blue panels

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A perfectly round white space helmet with a large curved gold visor and a grey neck ring with a small red connector.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, grey ring, red connector

cards.name: Space Gloves
cards.subject: A pair of white space gloves lying side by side, fingers slightly curled, each with a thick grey ring at the wrist and an orange band on the ring.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey rings, orange band

cards.name: Space Capsule
cards.subject: A cone-shaped space capsule resting on its wide flat base: a silver cone body with a dark grey heat shield base, a blunt rounded top and one round window with a yellow frame.
cards.hero_colors: silver, dark grey base, yellow window frame

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A silver tube telescope on a three-legged black tripod, tube pointing up at an angle, with a small red finder scope attached on top and an eyepiece at the lower end.
cards.hero_colors: silver, black tripod, red finder scope

cards.name: Joystick
cards.subject: A flight joystick: a round black base plate with a thick grey stick rising from its center, topped by a rounded black grip with one red button.
cards.hero_colors: black, grey stick, red button

cards.name: Radio Dish
cards.subject: A large white round dish on a short grey cylindrical base, tilted up to the sky, with a feed arm in front of it and an orange light on the base.
cards.hero_colors: white dish, grey base, orange light

cards.name: Base Dome
cards.subject: A moon base: a simple white half-sphere dome with a small round door at the front, one round window above it and an orange light on top.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey door, orange light
